body.name: Gaussian honest expected-diameter frontier
body.construction: \(\mathfrak R_{\alpha}^{G}(H,\Omega)=\inf_K\sup_{(h,b)\in\mathcal H_H}\mathbb E_{h,b,\Omega}[\operatorname{diam}(K(Z^{\mathrm{pan}}))]\), where the infimum is over measurable confidence kernels \(K:\mathbb R^p\rightsquigarrow2^{\mathbb R}\) satisfying \(\inf_{(h,b)\in\mathcal H_H}\Pr_{h,b,\Omega}\{\tau(h,b)\in K(Z^{\mathrm{pan}})\}\ge1-\alpha\).
